exclusion_reason: dist is generated from src by tsc; the exports compile src with tsc -p pi-extension/tsconfig.json before running the tests

real.defect: isSubagentContext recognises only the <active_agent name="..."/> tag. Configured subagents (Explorer, Reviewer, general-purpose) that identify themselves with the capability-disable marker are treated as main sessions.
real.consequence: Optional capabilities (Context Virtualization, Conversation History, Cognitive Routing) stay enabled inside subagent sessions: their prompts, skill directories, the freeflow_context tool and routing remain available to a child session that is meant to be isolated. Class note: this is a permission boundary, not a hostile input; the brief's security label is kept, and the owner may want to reclassify.
